current.name: Fmdac
current.description: Fmdac 0.5, identity FM-1_965. Eight tracks: KICK, SNARE, HAT, TOM, and silent MIDI tracks. SELECT, SEL, and K4 change the track. Press EDIT until the header says MAP. K1 selects a kit: GM, TR-909, TR-707, TR-727, TR-08, Volca Beats, or Hammerhead. K2 opens the next page of that chart. These are the published MIDI notes of those instruments. Hammerhead is the eight-note list the OCTACHRON author posted. The file does not contain every preset stored inside the OCTACHRON app. TR-707 and TR-727 use their shared notes 35 through 51. The original TR-808 has no MIDI, so the 808-style map is the TR-08 chart. Volca Beats part level is CC 40 through 49, and the channel starts at 1 so it can be matched to the unit. HOME cycles synthesized 808, 909, CR-78, and SDS characters. SEQ cycles a step grid, a keys-and-cursor piano roll, and a song chain. REC while stopped quantizes a short take and sets the BPM. FX runs Prophet VS, DX7, SP-1200, Emulator II, or S950. While the computer streams audio to the FM-1, that audio is converted on the way to the headphones. When nothing is streaming, the headphones hear the FM-1's own mix. No sample ROMs. The take is quantized, not a looper.
